Solution.S:
Let $(84-x)^{1/4} = t$. Then $84-x = t^4 \Rightarrow x = 84 - t^4$. As $x \to 3$, $t \to (84-3)^{1/4} = 81^{1/4} = 3$.

Thus the limit becomes:
$$\lim_{t \to 3} \frac{t-3}{(84 - t^4) - 3} = \lim_{t \to 3} \frac{t-3}{81 - t^4} = \lim_{t \to 3} \frac{t-3}{-(t^4-81)} = -\lim_{t \to 3} \frac{t-3}{t^4-81}.$$

Factor $t^4-81 = (t-3)(t+3)(t^2+9)$. Cancel $(t-3)$:
$$-\lim_{t \to 3} \frac{1}{(t+3)(t^2+9)} = -\frac{1}{(3+3)(9+9)} = -\frac{1}{6 \times 18} = -\frac{1}{108}.$$

Hence the correct answer is option A: $-\frac{1}{108}$.
